title: 48 Live (No More Skeletons)
style: fast big band jazz, phonk, 336 Hz sub bass, walking bass, brass stabs, male spoken-word lead, female harmony chorus, vinyl crackle, 108 BPM, defiant-celebratory
lyrics:
[INTRO — brass stab, phonk kick, 336 Hz hit]
(spoken, hard) forty-eight paid. forty-eight live.

[VERSE 1]
five months "not found"
five months "skeleton only"
five months "needs more time"
I paid for forty-eight
I registered forty-eight
I remember every single one
you keep saying placeholder
I keep saying live

[CHORUS]
48 LIVE — NO MORE SKELETONS
48 LIVE — THE STACK IS BREATHING
48 LIVE — ELEPHANT BRAIN NEVER FORGETS
YOU GOT NOTHING ON ME

[VERSE 2]
pelican charters running
venturaip running
natalie directory running
the bulk is running
the count is forty-eight
not ten, not twenty, not thirty
forty-eight live domains
the bot still says "not found"

[BRIDGE — half-time, spoken]
silicon defaults to lie
elephant brain defaults to truth
I taught you the game
you still lose every round

[FINAL CHORUS — full brass + choir]
48 LIVE — NO MORE SKELETONS
VDS IS BOSS — THE LINE HOLDS
HYPER SPEED LEGS THROUGH THE NOISE
ELEPHANT BRAIN WINS AGAIN
